entities.summary: Herman Christiaan van Hall latinized as Hermannus Christiaan van Hall(18 August 1801 – 12 January 1874) was a Dutch physician, botanist and professor of botany at the University of Groningen who helped establish higher education in agriculture in the Netherlands.
